kind: retrospective reuse of independent-seed games collected after retained-fault screens
unit: complete Tank War episode; first same-state local difference is the technical reference window
label_provenance: screened intervention manifest plus same-state raw-state, model request, selected action, and acknowledged command comparison
outcome_rule: fault-minus-clean score is reported separately; equal clean/fault outcomes do not exclude a local layer label
annotation_status: machine evidence only; no new human review
split: validation screens use 128 seed groups with both seats; collection uses distinct final_test seed groups
storage: labels and control manifest here; raw games, requests, replies, states, attempts and event logs remain in the pinned v0-pilot source directories referenced by private labels
blind_use: not certified as a fresh independent blind test; sample exposure must be audited before any diagnosis
limitations: One sustained fault family per layer; this is not a family-transfer test.
The harness strategy setting is used in observation and plan revalidation; its functional boundary is mixed.
A local change does not prove that it caused the whole-game loss.
Previously collected games may have appeared in development; do not claim a fresh blind test.
Harness collection is incomplete at 107/160 planned fault games; all 107 complete games are retained.
The original full #183 benchmark requires more independent fault families and human review.
independent_recheck_role: Post-collection descriptive check; original 128-seed validation screens remain the retention gate.
